rules.name: Present shared Home entry actions
rules.statement: Use one primary Home action and a paragraph containing the secondary route link. Resolve Site names through shared name/acronym substitutions. Preserve new-application reset and optional entry-notice gating. The shared QuickDecision notice reveals its icon once when at least half the notice enters view; honor reduced motion and product-driven applicability.
rules.source: User Home mockup and global-default clarification November 15, 2026; requirements/global/content/home.json; requirements/global/presentation-tokens.json; src/components/home/HomeHero.tsx; src/components/content/QuickDecisionInfoBox.tsx
